Subject: Decision requested: six-week invoice-handling pilot

Hi Morgan,

I’m seeking your approval for a six-week pilot to assess invoice handling, at a fixed fee of $30,000, subject to security clearance.

The pilot offers a focused way to examine the opportunity behind your goal of 20% shorter handling time without committing to a production rollout, which is explicitly excluded. As there is currently no baseline or measured savings, the pilot provides a practical assessment rather than assuming benefits in advance.

Security approval will be required before any access to client data. No start date has been approved; following your decision on scope and fee, we can align on security clearance and scheduling.

Could you please approve the pilot scope and $30,000 fixed fee, subject to security clearance? Your decision will allow us to move into planning while keeping production rollout outside this commitment.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
